blocks.text: Beeswin sadi ke aaghaz mein naye tajrubat aur nazariyati hisabat ne dikhaya ke Newton ke qawaneen par mabni classical physics intehai chhote zarron ya bohat zyada velocities wale mazahir ki wazahat nahi kar sakti. Is se relativistic mechanics bani, jo classical mechanics se zyada jame (comprehensive) dhancha thi aur jis ne kaainat ke baare mein hamara nazariya bunyadi taur par badal diya. 1905 mein pesh ki gayi Albert Einstein ki Special Theory of Relativity ne yeh masail hal kiye, yeh kehte hue ke physics ke qawaneen tamam observers ke liye ek hain aur light ki speed observer ki harkat se qata-e-nazar mustaqil hai. Is nazariye ne na sirf classical mechanics aur electromagnetic theory ke takrao hal kiye balke waqt, space aur harkat ki hamari samajh mein inqilab laya aur jadeed (modern) physics ki bunyad bana.

Socheye aap gend apne daen taraf phenkte hain. Aap ke saamne khare shakhs ko yeh simt us ki baen lagti hai; simt nisbati (relative) tasawwur hai. Isi tarah kisi cheez ka aaram ya harkat mein hona observer par munhasir hai. Maslan chalti train ki deewarein andar ke musafiron ko saakin lagti hain magar zameen par khare shakhs ko chalti nazar aati hain. Yun hum yaqeen se nahi keh sakte ke koi cheez mutlaq (absolute) aaram mein hai ya harkat mein; tamam harkatein observer, ya istemal hone wale frame of reference, ke nisbat hain.

Yeh is misal se wazeh hota hai. Band train ke dabbe mein ek observer dabbe ko apna frame of reference banata hai. Train ki harkat jaanne ke liye woh gend girata hai aur gend ka ufuqi faasla napta hai, har baar amudi faasla ek rakh kar; amudi faasla har soorat mein t seconds mein tay hota hai.

Train saakin hai. Gend ki ufuqi velocity sifar aur tay kiya ufuqi faasla bhi sifar hai. Train ke andar aur bahar wale observers ka mushahida ek jaisa hai: gend us nuqte ke bilkul neeche farsh par girti hai jahan se chhori gayi (Fig. 11.1a).

blocks.alt: Zameen par ruki train ki do tasveerein. Har aik mein dabbe ke andar aik shakhs haath aage kar ke gend chhorta hai; gend ki jagahein haath ke bilkul neeche farsh tak seedhi amudi (vertical) lakeer banati hain. Baen: train ke andar se. Daen: bahar khare shakhs ki nazar se. Har aik ke neeche: v = 0, koi ufuqi harkat nahi; gend seedhi neeche girti hai.
blocks.caption: Soorat (a): ruki train mein giri gend (Fig 11.1a ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dono observers aik hi cheez dekhte hain kyunke train, andar wala aur bahar wala sab aik doosre ke nisbat aaram mein hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono tasveerein dekhein: train ruki hui hai, is liye chhorte waqt gend ki koi ufuqi (sideways) speed nahi. Woh sirf gravity se girti hai aur haath ke bilkul neeche farsh par lagti hai. Andar wala aur bahar wala dono aik jaisa seedha girna dekhte hain, kyunke train ke nisbat koi bhi harkat mein nahi.
Soorat (b): train yaksan velocity v0 se chal rahi hai

Train yaksan velocity v0 se chal rahi hai. Chhorne par gend ki ibtidai ufuqi velocity v0 hai aur woh projectile ki tarah chalti hai, farsh tak pohanchne ke waqt t mein ufuqi faasla v0 t tay karti hai. Chunke train aur us ke andar ka observer bhi usi velocity v0 se chalte hain, woh bhi usi waqt mein utna hi faasla v0 t tay karte hain. Lihaza andar ka observer gend ko chhorne ki jagah ke bilkul neeche girta dekhta hai, jabke bahar ka observer gend ko projectile raste par chalta dekhta hai (Fig. 11.1b).

blocks.alt: Baen, andar se: daen taraf v0 se chalti train; andar aik shakhs gend chhorta hai aur gend ki jagahein haath ke neeche farsh tak seedhi amudi lakeer banati hain. Daen, zameen se: train wahan bhi dikhayi gayi hai jahan gend chhorte waqt thi (nuqtedaar) aur wahan bhi jahan gend girte waqt hai (theek lakeer), v0 t aage; gend ki jagahein pehli jagah ke haath se doosri jagah ke haath ke neeche farsh tak kham daar projectile rasta banati hain.
blocks.caption: Soorat (b): yaksan velocity v0 se chalti train mein giri gend (Fig 11.1b ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Girte hue gend train ki aage ki speed v0 rakhti hai, is liye musafir ke haath ke barabar rehti hai: musafir ke liye seedhi neeche, zameen wale ke liye projectile ka kham.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chhorne se pehle gend train ke saath v0 speed se aage chal rahi hoti hai, aur use koi peeche nahi dhakelta, is liye girte hue bhi woh yahi aage ki speed rakhti hai. Baen tasveer: aap bhi usi v0 se aage chal rahe hain, is liye aap ko gend sirf neeche jaati aur haath ke neeche girti dikhti hai. Daen tasveer: zameen par khara shakhs do harkatein aik saath dekhta hai, aage v0 aur neeche, jo mil kar kham daar (curved, projectile) rasta banati hain. Gend ke farsh tak pohanchne tak train, aap aur gend sab aik hi faasla v0 t aage chal chuke hote hain. Dono bayan durust hain; bas frame of reference mukhtalif hai.

blocks.title: Nateeja
blocks.text: Ek doosre ke nisbat yaksan velocity se chalte frames of reference ke observers harkat ko mukhtalif dekhte hain. Koi bayan ghalat nahi; har ek apne frame mein durust hai.

blocks.caption: Giri hui gend
rows: projectile rasta, v0 t bagal mein

blocks.prompt: Tamam harkatein nisbati hain. Kya space-time mutlaq hai (short question 11.8)? Relativistic mechanics kis speed se chalti cheezon ke liye classical mechanics se mukhtalif nataij deti hai (MCQ 11.1)?
blocks.explanation: Special relativity mein space aur time alag alag nisbati hain: mukhtalif inertial observers mukhtalif lambaiyan aur waqt napte hain. Space-time, jo dono ko jorta hai, do waqiaat ke darmiyan har inertial observer ke liye ek hi faasla (interval) deta hai, to yeh mushtarka dhancha hai; aur Einstein ki general theory mein khud mass se kham-daar hota hai. Relativistic nataij classical se numayan taur par sirf light ki speed ke qareeb speeds par mukhtalif hote hain, option (d).

items: Newtonian physics bohat chhote zarron aur bohat tez speeds par nakaam hai; Einstein ki special theory (1905): physics ke qawaneen tamam observers ke liye ek aur light ki speed mustaqil.
Aaram aur harkat nisbati hain. Yaksan chalti train mein giri gend musafir ke liye seedhi neeche magar bahar wale ke liye projectile raste par girti hai (Fig. 11.1).
